$comment: Intentional removals of public operations. The compatibility gate (scripts/check-api-compatibility.py) refuses any removed operation unless it is listed here with a reason and the PR that reviewed it. Only 'operation removed' can be waived; contract changes on live operations still require a new API version. Remove an entry once the base branch no longer contains the operation.

removed_operations.reason: Security finding H1: unauthenticated acceptance granted membership to anyone holding the one-time token and revealed whether an email was registered. The OIDC browser flow (verified-email ID token) is the only supported path.
